title: quartifyr render result
description: What `Rscript inst/scripts/render.R --json` prints on stdout, and the fields of render_report()'s return value. `status` describes whether the delivered document is complete: "error" means unfilled placeholders or a failed requested post-processing step (or, for a render that stopped early, the error in `errors`); "warning" means complete but flagged (e.g. a missing metadata sidecar); "ok" means nothing to report.

shell.description: Path to the rendered shell docx.

draft.description: Path to the draft docx filled by reportifyr.

final.description: Path to the final docx; null unless status was final.

artifacts.description: The files that exist, with SHA-256 hashes.

unfilled_placeholders.description: {rpfy}: magic strings still present in the draft/final docx.

missing_metadata.description: Artifacts referenced by the shell that have no metadata sidecar.

log_dir.description: reportifyr's log directory for the project.

error_class.description: Only present on failure: the R condition class, e.g. quartifyr_quarto_timeout, quartifyr_render_incomplete.
